source:
@@U01635@@
You pretty little thing,
you mustn't let him frighten you.

@@U01637@@
His presence makes my blood run cold.
I try to be nice to everyone;
and I so long to see you,
but I’m secretly horrified by that man.
Besides, I think he’s a scoundrel.
God forgive me if I misjudge him!

@@U01639@@
It takes all kinds to make a world.

@@U01641@@
I wouldnt’ like living with a man like him.
He no sooner comes in the door
than he looks around in mockery and half in a rage.
He has no interests;
he’s interested in nothing;
its written all over his face.
And there’s not a living soul he can love.
With you I’m so free and easy,
so happy and content in your arms;
but just his presence strangles my very soul.

@@U01643@@
What a foreboding little angel you are!

@@U01645@@
He has only to come near
and I feel overwhelmed,
almost as if I don’t love you anymore.
And I can’t pray with him in the room,
and that nearly breaks my heart.
Dear 海因里希,
you must feel that, too!
translation:
@@U01635@@
你这个漂亮的小东西，
你一定不能让他吓到你。

@@U01637@@
他的出现让我浑身发冷。
我努力对每个人都友善；
我很想见到你，
但我暗自对那个男人感到害怕。
另外，我认为他是个恶棍。
如果我误判了他，上帝原谅我！

@@U01639@@
创造一个世界需要各种各样的东西。

@@U01641@@
我不想和他这样的人住在一起。
他一进门
然后他带着嘲弄和半愤怒的表情环顾四周。
他没有兴趣；
他对什么都不感兴趣；
这一切都写在他的脸上。
而且没有一个活生生的灵魂是他可以爱的。
和你在一起我如此自由自在
在你的怀里是多么幸福和满足；
但光是他的存在就扼杀了我的灵魂。

@@U01643@@
你真是个不祥的小天使啊！

@@U01645@@
他只需靠近
我感到不知所措，
几乎就好像我不再爱你了。
我不能和他一起在房间里祈祷，
这几乎让我心碎。
亲爱的海因里希，
你一定也有这样的感觉！
